en: Data Section. Dictation. Ninth of March, ninety-nine.
Year field remediation, batch fourteen. Two hundred and six forms checked. Eleven still keep the year in two digits.
The pensions ledger wants four digits. The bus pass ledger wants two. Each says the other one is wrong.
For the file: the dehumidifier in the tape cupboard was unplugged again. Somebody needed the socket for a kettle.
Batch fifteen on Monday. End of dictation.
zh: 数据组，口述记录。九九年三月九号。
年份字段整改，第十四批。查了两百零六张表，还有十一张把年份存成两位数。
养老金台账要四位，巴士月票台账要两位，两边都说对方错。
另记一笔：磁带柜的除湿机又被拔了插头，有人要用插座烧水。
第十五批下周一做。口述完毕。
